details:
This update for rust-keylime fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-115905: zip: security control bypass via parser differential between central directory and local headers
  (bsc#1287921)
- CVE-2026-115906: zip: authentication bypass in AES encrypted entries due to improper HMAC verification (bsc#1287921)
- CVE-2026-115907: zip: denial of service via unbounded memory allocation in legacy decoders (bsc#1287921)
- CVE-2026-115908: zip: path traversal via lexical symlink validation during extraction (bsc#1287921)
- CVE-2026-115909: zip: denial of service via uncontrolled memory allocation on symlink targets (bsc#1287921)

Changes for rust-keylime:

- Update to version 0.2.10+12:
 * log Agent UUID at push agent startup
 * Limit actix-web workers
 * Fix clippy needless_late_init warnings
 * Unwrap OCTET STRING wrapped EK certificates
 * build(deps): bump rand from 0.9.4 to 0.10.1
 * build(deps): bump glob from 0.3.3 to 0.3.4
 * build(deps): bump reqwest from 0.13.3 to 0.13.4
 * Check shutdown marker inside ml_extend loop
 * Fix clippy useless_borrows_in_formatting warnings
 * build(deps): bump tokio from 1.52.2 to 1.53.1
 * Fix payload key upgrade regression by falling back to mTLS key
 * Accept any RSA key size for payload encryption
 * Bump version to 0.2.10
 * keylime: use runtime OpenSSL algorithm detection instead of compile-time symbols
